items.text: An MBA in HR leads to talent acquisition, HR operations, learning and development, compensation and HR business partner roles, and growth depends on handling real employee situations, learning labour rules and showing results through numbers such as time to hire and retention.
Start in one HR function, learn the rules that apply to it and build proof such as a hiring tracker or a training plan.
Check the current rules before advising anyone.
